title: Gemma 4 E2B/E4B corroboration, endpoint inversions, and currentness
question: Which E2B/E4B directions recur across independent agentic, clinical, audio, edge-runtime, Apple-runtime, and MTP evidence; which same-instrument inversions prevent a universal ranking; and what changed in the PLE support question since the predecessor run?

inclusion_criteria: Prefer versioned papers, commit-pinned code or reports, raw tables, and primary mutable issue state.
Count independent origin groups rather than pages, rows, repositories mirrored by the same study, or downstream retellings.
Preserve paired metric directions, denominators, local inversions, runtime identity, task shape, and reproducibility gaps.
Use the predecessor Gemma 4 packets as bounded prior context without rewriting their observations.
exclusion_criteria: Do not aggregate unlike endpoint metrics into one family score or universal E2B/E4B ranking.
Do not interpret runtime allocation or short generation at 256K as semantic usable-context proof.
Do not treat issue closure, README summaries, or architecture labels as stronger than the underlying state, detailed reports, code, and official architecture evidence.
Do not promote web observations into canonical model source, runtime admission, proof, or owner fit.

generality_probe.rationale: The same family is tested through unrelated tasks, origins, hardware generations, and runtimes to distinguish recurring direction from one-instrument preference.

clusters.label: E2B resource and decode direction repeats across independent local routes
clusters.supported_scope: Three added independent field origins place E2B ahead of E4B on decode throughput, memory, or constrained-device completion, reinforcing the predecessor's H100, energy, and OpenVINO resource-side direction.
transfer_limits: Quantization, checkpoint identity, runtime, hardware, prompt, context, repetitions, and output length are not held constant across origins.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: No owner run combines exact artifacts, accepted outputs, memory, energy, thermal behavior, and repeated reliability.
clusters.next_action: Use E2B as the resource-side study candidate and measure an exact realization rather than importing any published ratio.

clusters.label: E4B usually leads capability or all-run reliability in unrelated instruments
clusters.supported_scope: Independent tool-use, clinical multimodal, and audio-criticism studies place E4B ahead on most captured aggregate, consistency, or task-aligned endpoints.
transfer_limits: No common checkpoint revisions, prompts, runtimes, tasks, or owner utility connect these instruments.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: Per-item outputs, variance, exact revisions, deployment cost, and AoA workload acceptance remain incomplete.
clusters.next_action: Use E4B as the capability-side study candidate while preserving endpoint-specific counterevidence.

clusters.label: Same-instrument endpoint inversions rule out a global family ranking
clusters.supported_scope: Each otherwise E4B-favorable instrument contains a bounded E2B endpoint lead, showing that reliability definition, task, prompt, and metric can change the local ordering.
transfer_limits: The inversions range from small differences to weak absolute outcomes and do not establish a general E2B capability advantage.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: Uncertainty, per-item decomposition, prompt sensitivity, and replicated endpoint stability remain incomplete.
clusters.next_action: Retain metric-specific directions and forbid a scalar family rank before owner weighting.

clusters.label: MTP sign depends on backend and task shape
clusters.supported_scope: Two code-bearing origins expose positive, neutral, and negative MTP rows; one changes direction by task and the other changes sign between PyTorch/MPS and MLX on one machine.
transfer_limits: Repetition, token counting, accepted-token rate, output parity, revisions, and workload mix remain incomplete or differ.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: No common break-even curve spans output length, task predictability, backend, precision, batch, concurrency, and semantic acceptance.
clusters.next_action: Admit MTP only through exact target/assistant/runtime workload evidence with output acceptance.

clusters.label: Allocated and completed context remains distinct from semantic usable context
clusters.supported_scope: Synthetic 256K execution and PLE placement currentness reinforce that context admission depends on allocation, completion, placement, and semantic grading rather than one nominal number.
transfer_limits: The sources do not run a common semantic long-context task or exact runtime realization.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: Position-sensitive retrieval/reasoning, repeated completion, memory, thermal, and corruption checks are absent at long context.
clusters.next_action: Measure nominal, allocated, completed, and semantically usable context as separate owner-study outputs.

clusters.label: Source-internal semantic defects must be isolated from inspectable measurements
clusters.supported_scope: A wrong architecture label and a positive top-level synthesis coexist with inspectable raw or detailed results that support narrower runtime observations.
transfer_limits: Manual review is still required to decide which source layer remains usable; source class alone cannot decide it.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: No generic semantic checker can infer architecture truth or reconcile summary/detail intent without owner evidence.
clusters.next_action: Audit subject metadata, method, raw data, and conclusion as separate layers before counting an origin.

tensions.label: Usual E4B advantage versus local E2B endpoints
tensions.analysis: The evidence is compatible after preserving metric and task axes: E4B leads most aggregate or consistency outcomes, while E2B can lead a different endpoint in the same instrument.
tensions.remaining_question: Which endpoint definitions and task weights represent AoA utility?

tensions.label: Positive MTP averages versus route-level slowdowns
tensions.analysis: Backend, task shape, output length, precision, and implementation change the realized speculative-decoding economics, so a model-family multiplier is unsupported.
tensions.remaining_question: Where is the break-even surface for the exact AoA route and workload distribution?

tensions.label: Closed issue state versus unresolved PLE-specific support
tensions.analysis: Issue lifecycle state and runtime capability are different axes: stale closure updates currentness but does not create a supported device map or resolve context-placement behavior.
tensions.remaining_question: Will a named Transformers version publish and verify an exact PLE placement route?

method_pressures.pressure: One source can support opposite E2B/E4B directions on different legitimate endpoints, making source-level votes and scalar ranking lossy.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Track recurrence by metric, denominator, task, and direction; treat same-instrument endpoint inversion as positive evidence against universal ordering.

method_pressures.pressure: README labels or summaries can conflict with official architecture or the source's own detailed backend reports while underlying artifacts remain useful.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Audit metadata, method, raw data, detailed report, and conclusion independently, and count them as one origin rather than multiple votes.

method_pressures.pressure: A requested context can allocate and finish a short synthetic generation without establishing semantic usability or changing the provider contract.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Separate nominal model context, runtime allocation, execution completion, and semantically graded usable context in future observations.

method_pressures.pressure: Versioned paper-only, commit-pinned report, code-pinned, raw-data-pinned, and exact-checkpoint-pinned sources support different depths of reproduction.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Expose a reproducibility posture derived from retained method, code, raw data, environment, checkpoint, and repeated-run identity without replacing qualitative review.

method_pressures.pressure: A later mutable issue state can be observed even when no earlier locator-bounded capture snapshot exists for mechanical change classification.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Allow a qualified observation supersession proposal while refusing to fabricate a ResearchChangeReceipt without two resolvable snapshots.

revisit_triggers: T1-Bench releases versioned code, data, per-task outputs, checkpoint revisions, or an independent rerun.
The INSPECT or AudioProcessBench studies publish exact inference artifacts, uncertainty, per-item outputs, or independent replications.
A paired E2B/E4B owner study combines exact artifacts, accepted outputs, pass-at-least-once, all-run reliability, TTFT, prefill, decode, memory, energy, thermal state, and retries.
A code-bearing MTP study publishes exact target/assistant revisions, acceptance, byte or semantic parity, repeated variance, batch/concurrency, and output-length break-even curves across backends.
A semantic long-context study tests exact E2B/E4B realizations at multiple positions beyond 128K rather than only allocating and generating a short continuation.
Transformers publishes or verifies an exact PLE device_map route, or issue 47705 receives a technical reopening, linked fix, or fixed-version reproduction.
Another model family reproduces metric-direction inversion, source-internal contradiction, or the four-layer context-admission pressure strongly enough to justify method v0.4.
